findings.title: getSessionId fragmentation: 7 implementations with 4 distinct fallback semantics in hooks src; shared barrel re-exports the ppid-scheme under the canonical name
findings.observe_how: Caller map (non-test src). Scheme A session-id.ts (COORDINATION_SESSION_ID env > ~/.claude/.coordination-session-id file > BRAINTRUST_SPAN_ID > s-<ts36>): file-claims.ts, heartbeat.ts, session-register.ts, session-start-parallel.ts; composed into getBusId by session-bus-id.ts which feeds context-bus.ts default bus id. Scheme B session-isolation.ts (CLAUDE_SESSION_ID > hostname-PID): maestro-cleanup, maestro-enforcer, maestro-state-manager, plan-exit-tracker, plan-to-ralph-enforcer, ralph-delegation-enforcer, smarter-everyday (7 hooks via state-path helpers). Scheme C private clones (CLAUDE_SESSION_ID > ppid/pid/undefined variants): guardrail-enforcer.ts:98, lib/hook-trace.ts:34, shared/logger.ts:72, shared/resource-reader.ts:70. NEW beyond SEED-12's '2 competing schemes': the 4 private clones, and shared/index.ts:101 re-exports resource-reader's ppid-scheme as the barrel's `getSessionId` — any future `import { getSessionId } from './shared/index.js'` silently gets a per-process ppid id, not the coordination id. Consequence: state files, traces, guardrail acks, and coordination rows for the SAME session carry non-joinable ids.
findings.telemetry: corr-null 60.7% on intel-bus rows is consistent with id-scheme mismatch across emitting hooks; hook-trace.jsonl sessionId (pid-based) can never join sessions table ids (s-<ts36>).

findings.title: Stale fork .claude/scripts/sync-claude.sh ships to ~/.claude with NO clobber guard, reverse-sync as no-arg DEFAULT, and a mis-rooted REPO_CLAUDE that targets <parent>/.claude/.claude

evidence.quote:
# Pre-flight 2 (2026-06-01): refuse reverse-sync if the REPO has uncommitted
    # changes in the synced dirs. Reverse-sync (active -> repo) would overwrite
    # fresh repo edits with the active copy -- the exact clobber that reverted

findings.observe_how: diff scripts/sync-claude.sh .claude/scripts/sync-claude.sh -> `55,74d54` (the entire Pre-flight 2 dirty-repo abort, added 2026-06-01 in commit 4631b43, is ABSENT from the .claude copy, last touched 2026-05-31 in 651f520). Forward sync (SYNC_DIRS includes `scripts`) installs this fork at ~/.claude/scripts/sync-claude.sh. Run there with no args: DIRECTION defaults to to-repo; REPO_ROOT=dirname(~/.claude/scripts)=~/.claude so REPO_CLAUDE=~/.claude/.claude (copies the active tree into a nested ~/.claude/.claude junk mirror — same doubled-path family as SEED-07); AUDIT_SCRIPT resolves to ~/.claude/scripts/audit-braintrust-emits.sh which does not exist, so the `[ -f ]` check silently SKIPS the audit gate. Net: the executable whose unguarded twin destroyed repo edits twice (per .claude/rules/git-sync-workflow.md) exists in the active environment with BOTH safety gates inert and a contamination-producing target, one no-arg invocation away.
findings.telemetry: Check for existence of ~/.claude/.claude/ nested dir as the smoking gun of a past invocation.

findings.title: Sync sprawl: 6 in-repo code paths for the single repo<->active sync relationship; the duplicated pairs have already drifted on a safety fix

evidence.quote:
# up two levels: .claude/scripts -> .claude -> repo root (this copy is one level deeper than scripts/sync-to-active.sh)
REPO_ROOT="$(dirname "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")")"

* PostToolUse hook that auto-syncs ~/.claude changes to continuous-claude repo.
 * Triggers when hooks, skills, rules, scripts, or agents are modified.

findings.observe_how: The 6 paths: (1) scripts/sync-to-active.sh (canonical forward, 271 ln); (2) .claude/scripts/sync-to-active.sh (272-ln near-duplicate; sole diff is the REPO_ROOT depth comment+line — and when forward-synced to ~/.claude/scripts its own dirname(dirname()) math degrades REPO_ROOT to $HOME, making REPO_CLAUDE=$HOME/.claude=ACTIVE_CLAUDE, i.e. a self-copy no-op); (3) scripts/sync-claude.sh (bidirectional, guarded, 140 ln); (4) .claude/scripts/sync-claude.sh (120-ln stale fork — see D7d-02); (5) scripts/post-commit-hook.sh (auto-invokes #1 on every commit); (6) .claude/hooks/src/sync-to-repo.ts (deliberately unregistered after the 2026-06-01 clobber incident but source retained, header still claims 'Registered for: PostToolUse:Write|Edit'). Every sync behavior change must land in 2+ copies; D7d-02 is the proof the double-landing already failed once (guard landed in #3, never in #4). Fix: delete the two .claude/scripts copies (the canonical pair under scripts/ is what docs and the post-commit hook reference) and either delete sync-to-repo.ts or correct its header.
findings.telemetry: git log -1 per copy: scripts/sync-claude.sh @2026-06-01 vs .claude/scripts/sync-claude.sh @2026-05-31 — drift measurable as divergent last-touch dates on supposed duplicates.

findings.title: Ralph state machinery verdict: LIVE (8 registered hooks + templates drive ralph-state-v2.py) — but ralph-state.py v1 is dead code and opc/scripts/ralph/ holds 3 byte-identical orphaned test copies
findings.observe_how: USED side: .claude/settings.json registers 8 ralph hooks (ralph-delegation-enforcer, ralph-enforcer, ralph-monitor, ralph-progress-inject, ralph-retry-reminder, ralph-task-monitor, ralph-template-inject, ralph-watchdog .mjs); ralph-checkpoint.py:33-35 and ralph-progress-sync.py:77-81 both resolve and shell out to ralph-state-v2.py; PROMPT_BUILD.md template and ralph SKILL.md reference v2 — so do NOT delete the v2 chain. DEAD side: ralph-state.py (v1, superseded by v2 per its own naming) is referenced by exactly ONE file repo-wide — itself (ripgrep `ralph-state\.py` over the whole repo returns only .claude/scripts/ralph/ralph-state.py; a second grep over .claude/skills, hooks/src, templates, scripts, docs excluding _snapshots returned zero external refs). opc/scripts/ralph/ contains exactly 3 files (test_extract_agent_learnings.py, test_memory_integration.py, test_prepare_agent_context.py), each cmp-IDENTICAL to its .claude/scripts/ralph/ sibling, with no implementation files alongside — orphaned duplicate test copies. Fix: delete ralph-state.py and opc/scripts/ralph/.
findings.telemetry: n/a — static dead-code; re-verify with `rg 'ralph-state\.py'` before deletion.

findings.title: 11 git-tracked tmpclaude-*-cwd junk artifacts committed into .claude/scripts/ (9) and .claude/hooks/src/ (2), with no .gitignore pattern to stop recurrence
findings.observe_how: git ls-files | grep tmpclaude -> 11 tracked files: .claude/hooks/src/tmpclaude-{681c,9453}-cwd and .claude/scripts/tmpclaude-{0070,0a6c,1fd7,2394,26d6,8ae4,a6eb,afb4,b3ea}-cwd. Each is a ~37-byte single-line cwd capture (Bash-tool working-directory temp files that leaked into source dirs and were swept up by bulk `git add` — e.g. ef00c22 added the scripts batch). Because .claude/scripts and the repo skills/rules dirs forward-sync, the junk also propagates to ~/.claude/ where directory scanners (Codex .agents mirror, skill scanners) enumerate it. grep tmpclaude .gitignore -> no match, so nothing prevents the next batch from being committed. This is a NEW committed-artifact instance of the SEED-06 stray-junk family (SEED-06 itself covers the untracked scripts/.claude/logs artifact). Fix: git rm the 11 files + add `tmpclaude-*` to .gitignore.
findings.telemetry: `git ls-files | grep -c tmpclaude` should be 0 after fix; recurrence detectable by the same count going non-zero.

notes: All findings VERIFIED by reading working-tree files at the frozen SHA; no tests executed, no writes. Read-only Bash used only for ls/diff/cmp/git-log/grep.
